items.question: What is Enfosi?
items.answer: Enfosi is a Roblox experience by Tumore. Defend a statue while identifying disguised Enphosians among innocent Glaggles. Weapons, tools and classes change how you play.

items.question: What is the current update?
items.answer: The official description currently advertises SMILE MORE, an overhaul with new content and Maniac difficulty. This site checked it on 13 October 2026.

items.question: Can I play on mobile?
items.answer: The developer recommends PC. Its description says other devices work but are not the intended setup; this site has not tested every touch or controller control.

items.question: Are there verified Enfosi codes here?
items.answer: A current redemption interface and valid rewards were not verified in the launch research. No placeholder codes are published. This does not prove the game has no code system.

items.question: Is this wiki official?
items.answer: No. Enfosi Guide Wiki is an independent fan site, not affiliated with or endorsed by Tumore or Roblox.
